decision.summary: Hold the open 79k reach position and skip any fresh entries this cycle.
decision.rationale: The latest Beecthor transcript and recent summaries still frame BTC as a corrective rebound inside a larger bearish map, but they continue to allow a stretch toward the 79k area before any renewed downside. That keeps the open `will-bitcoin-reach-79k-on-may-3` Yes position coherent, and at roughly 67% probability it is still well below the 80-85% partial take-profit band and far from the 90-95% full take-profit zone. Binance does not justify adding new risk: BTC is in a lateral short-term regime, sitting inside a tight 24-48h range near 78.1k-79.2k with no clean breakout above the local highs and no bearish rejection breakdown either. Under the playbook no-trade gate, that makes new daily or weekly entries invalid here: 80k daily reach is too weak for the remaining 5.8h, bearish dips lack the required rejection evidence, and the weekly board is too low-quality with the same near-term expiry.
